prerequisites: Fundamental programming concepts, data structures, and algorithms
Basic notions of data management and databases

learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to AI and Business Intelligence (BI) analytics research and practice.

Ability to plan a data analytics campaign on an unknown analytical problem and unknown domain, starting from generalizable tools and being able to obtain valid baseline results that the student will learn how to evaluate appropriately.
Develop communication skills and transversal competencies (collaboration, cooperation, organization) through verbal presentation of the course project.

syllabus_topics: Overview of AI and Data Mining research design
Planning and execution of an analytics campaign
Practical experience with planning and executing an analytics project
Importance of data quality in analytics
Best practices for ensuring high-quality data
Practical exercises to apply data quality techniques
Design principles for effective data analytics systems
Data Mesh design patterns and concepts
Practical application of data design and reporting
Shallow learning models and their application in real-world scenarios
Errors and assumptions in machine learning
assessment_rules: The deliverable is evaluated in terms of correctness, completeness, and compatibility of the work with the subject matter. The final grade is based on project work and its verbal (30%) and written (70%) reporting.
bibliography: "Fundamentals of Business Intelligence" grossmann w.; rinderle-ma s. 2015.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
